verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only prebuilt Agents Dashboards (Model Cost widget, tool calls, tool errors and durations). Nothing documents letting a user build custom dashboards, and nothing covers eval-score metrics. Fixed dashboards are an adjacent feature, not the custom dashboard-building capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can build custom dashboards over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics
